content.text:
Nvidia Stock Is in for Cathie Wood’s ARK and This AI Play Is Out
Nvidia stock was slipping early Tuesday amid headwinds for the entire semiconductor sector. But ARK Invest’s Cathie Wood is still a fan of the chip maker, with her funds snapping up Nvidia shares and selling Advanced Micro Devices.
